mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,monthly_amount,execute_day,status,created_at,updated_at FROM auto_invest_plan WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'

SELECT p.fund_id,p.monthly_amount,COALESCE(f.fund_code,'') AS fund_code,COALESCE(f.name,'已下架基金') AS fund_name FROM auto_invest_plan_fund p LEFT JOIN fund f ON f.id=p.fund_id WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId} AND p.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY p.fund_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fund WHERE deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_invest_plan(user_id,monthly_amount,execute_day) VALUES(#{userId},#{r.monthlyAmount},#{r.executeDay}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE monthly_amount=#{r.monthlyAmount},execute_day=#{r.executeDay},deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE auto_invest_plan_fund SET deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_invest_plan_fund(plan_id,fund_id,monthly_amount) VALUES (#{planId},#{f.fundId},#{f.monthlyAmount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE monthly_amount=VALUES(monthly_amount),deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO audit_log(actor_user_id,actor_role,action,object_type,object_id,object_name,detail,trace_id,occurred_at) VALUES(#{userId},1,8,'auto_invest_plan',#{planId},'定投计划',CAST(#{detail} AS JSON),#{traceId},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
